messages:
Ivy: Planning to land docs PR #612 (migration guide + Python SDK examples) in the 17:30 docs merge window. Vercel preview is green but Netlify deploy errored with an artifact write conflict. Should we wait or do a content-only merge?
Diego: build-bot shows: 
build-bot: Preview build failed for branch docs/python-sdk-612 — Error: EEXIST writing artifact shard 3. Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/2005123420#logs
Nora: Two quick options: (A) replace the oversized SVG atlas with a lightweight PNG and re-trigger preview, (B) merge content-only now and follow up with an assets PR. I prefer A to keep previews healthy.
Ivy: If the asset swap is <12 minutes let's do A. Diego, can you push an optimized asset?
Diego: Yup, pushing a reduced PNG and updating the PR now. Local smoke I ran:
```
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build --clean
mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000
```
Snippet renders locally, links to API refs require correct site_url to test fully.
Nora: Quick content review notes: the migration step about prefix caching needs the exact CLI flag shown; added an inline snippet and small wording fix. Also updated alt text on the new image.
Ivy: Approvals in-thread: Nora approved content changes. Diego please confirm the preview once deploy finishes. Also remember to add `merge: gated` label if CI still running when we merge.
build-bot: New deploy attempt started: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/2005123505 (in progress).
Diego: Deploy succeeded: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/2005123505 — preview looks correct on my end.
QA-bot: Quick automated checks: 1) markdown lint passed, 2) code block languages present, 3) no inline TODOs found. Minor warning: external link to partner article redirects (not blocking).
Ivy: Great. With approvals and green preview I'm going to merge at 17:31. Reminder to include commit message: `docs: python sdk migration + examples (#612) — docs-release` and add an item to the release-notes board.
Diego: Approved and noted. I'll run a post-merge smoke to verify live pages for 404s.
Nora: Leaving a post-merge follow-up to reintroduce high-res assets behind CDN headers in a separate PR.
Ivy: Merged at 17:31. Thanks everyone, closing thread.
